question: Do you have a favourite teacher?
follow_ups: Do you want to be a teacher in the future?
Are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?
diagnosis_line_zh: 54 个词里你把同一句「我没有喜欢的老师」说了两遍，理由 0 次、例子 0 次、让步 0 次。你这道题的问题不是语法，是说完就没有了。
answer_raw: Actually, I don't have kind of favorite teacher. I'm an introvert person, so you know, I don't have a deep relationship with my favorite teachers. They just teach me knowledge, I just sit on my chair and listen to them and learn knowledge, just common interacts. And I don't have kind of favorite teacher.
scaffold_zh: 否定（as such）→ 给原因（我不亲近）→ 给细节（上课·记笔记）→ 转向（真正教我最多的不是人）

fixes.original: I don't have kind of favorite teacher
fixes.fixed: I don't really have a favourite teacher, as such.
fixes.core: I don't really have a favourite teacher, as such.
fixes.rule_zh: 「没有那种最喜欢的老师」不是 don't have kind of ...。really 放在 have 前面，句尾补一个 as such，就是母语者的否定方式。kind of 只能修饰形容词，不能套名词。
fixes.prompt_zh: 严格说来，我没有什么特别喜欢的老师。

fixes.label_zh: 关系不深不是 deep relationship
fixes.original: I don't have a deep relationship with my favorite teachers
fixes.fixed: I was never close to any of them.
fixes.core: I was never close to any of them.
fixes.rule_zh: be close to somebody 是万能搭配。deep relationship 在英语里指灵魂层面的深交，用来说师生关系会过重，考官会愣一下。
fixes.prompt_zh: 我跟他们当中任何一个都不亲近。

fixes.fixed: They delivered the lesson, I took the notes, and that was that.
fixes.rule_zh: teach me knowledge 是中文直译，knowledge 不可数也不这么用。把动作具体化：deliver the lesson 上课、take notes 记笔记、explain a concept 讲概念。具体动词比 knowledge 这种大词值钱得多。
fixes.prompt_zh: 他们就是上课，我记笔记，然后就结束了。

chunks.wrong: I don't have kind of favorite teacher
chunks.example: I don't have a favourite teacher as such — I had plenty of good ones, just none I'd single out.
chunks.usage_zh: 放在名词后面，表示「谈不上是这个东西，但有相近的」。任何 Part 1 否定题都能救场：I'm not a big reader as such, but...

chunks.wrong: have a deep relationship with my teachers
chunks.example: I was never close to my teachers; I sat at the back and left without saying anything.
chunks.usage_zh: 关系好用 close to，主语是人：We're not close. / I've never been close to him. 名词形式是 closeness。

chunks.zh: 脑子里第一个冒出来的
chunks.wrong: it just comes out in my mind that my parents help me the most
chunks.example: When someone asks who shaped me, what comes to mind is a screen, not a classroom.
chunks.usage_zh: come to mind 不需要介词，更不说 come out in my mind。万能开头：What comes to mind is... / The first thing that comes to mind is...

model_answer: I don't really have a favourite teacher, as such.
I've had good teachers, but I was never close to any of them — I'm the quiet one who sits at the back.
They delivered the lesson, I took the notes, and that was that.
If you ask who's actually taught me the most recently, what comes to mind isn't a person at all — it's an AI.
It answers questions without judging me for asking them, which is exactly what I couldn't do in a classroom.
answer_note_zh: 最后两句没有编任何东西：你自己在另一份稿子里说过「最近帮我最多的就是 AI，它给我答案，我就照做」。把这句话放进「你最喜欢的老师」里，就从一个没话说的回答变成了一个有观点的回答。这才是 7 分到 8 分的路。
